headlines.title: 석유최고가격 석 달만에 인하 … L당 150원씩
headlines.summary: 전기·가스 등 공공요금 동결 1조 투입해 2%대 물가 사수 정부가 중동 전쟁 이전 수준으로 떨어진 국제 유가를 반영해 휘발유와 경유 최고가격을 각각 L당 1784원, 1773원으로 150원씩 내리기로 했다. 석유제품 최고가격을 내린 것은 지난 3월 제도 시행 후 처음이다.

headlines.title: 휘발유 150원 내린다 … 최고가 석달만에 인하
headlines.summary: 정부 ‘최고가 하향’ 오늘부터 적용 하반기 전기-가스요금도 동결키로 농축수산물 할인 등엔 1조 투입 물가상승률 3% 이내 억제 총력전 뉴시스 국제유가가 중동전쟁 이전 수준까지 떨어지면서 정부가 석유 최고가격을 3개월 만에 낮추기로 했다. 다만 중동 정세 불안이 여전하다고 보고 최고가격제는 유지하기로 했다.

headlines.title: 1조 이상 투입 … 계란·돼지고기 할인하고 전기료 동결
headlines.summary: [정부, 최대규모 물가안정 대책 마련] 농축수산물 모든 품목 할인행사 석유 최고가도 리터당 150원 ↓ 휘발유·경유 판매가 하락 기대 하반기 상승률 2% 안팎 묶기로 26일 서울 시내의 한 대형마트에 고등어가 진열되어 있다. 정부는 이날 쌀·양파·계란·돼지·고등어 등 농축수산물 전 품목에 제한 없이 3500억 원 규모의 할인 행사를 추진한다고 발표했다.

headlines.title: 삼계탕 2만2천원 · 냉면 1만8천원 … "더위 식히려다 가격에 열불나"
headlines.summary: 5년새 삼계탕 26%·냉면 35% ↑ 4인가족 외식 한끼에 10만원 한우 양지·닭고기값 급등에 임대료·인건비도 부담 커져 자영업자·소비자 모두 한숨 정부, 농축수산물 3500억 할인 지원액 1인당 3만원으로 늘려 외식물가가 지속해서 오르면서 서민 지갑을 위협하는 가운데 26일 서울의 한 식당 광고판에 삼계탕 가격이 안내돼 있다.

headlines.title: 대기업서 중기·자영업자로 … 5년새 바뀐 국책銀 부실 주범
headlines.summary: 대기업 부실비율 3분의1로 뚝 중기·자영업자는 꾸준히 상승 경기부진에 건전성 양극화 국책은행 기업대출 부실의 무게중심이 대기업에서 중소기업·자영업자로 옮겨가고 있다. 조선·해운 등 대기업 구조조정 관련 부실은 상당 부분 정리된 반면, 고금리와 경기 부진이 길어지면서 상환 여력이 약한 중소기업과 자영업자 부실이 빠르게 불어난 영향이다.

headlines.title: 환전 대신 달러 쌓는 기업들 … 외화예금 늘어도 환율 고공행진
headlines.summary: 거주자 외화예금 잔액 1122억 달러 개인은 팔고 기업은 달러 곳간 채웠다 원달러 환율 1550원 선 위협 원·달러 환율이 1,500원대 중반을 이어가고 있는 26일 서울 중구 명동의 환전소에서 외국인 관광객들이 환전을 하기 위해 대기하고 있다. 뉴스 1 지난달 국내 거주자의 외화예금이 기업들의 달러화 예금 증가에 힘입어 두 달 연속 늘었다.

headlines.title: 환율 한달반 가까이 1500원대 … 장중 1550원 육박, 외환당국 개입한 듯
headlines.summary: [휘발유값 150원 인하] 美금리 인상 가능성-외인 “팔자” 겹쳐 시장선 “다시 1550원 뚫을수도” 원·달러 환율이 1500원대 중반을 이어가고 있는 26일 오후 서울 중구 명동의 환전소에서 외국인 관광객들이 환전을 하기 위해 대기하고 있다. 2026.6.26 뉴스1 원-달러 환율이 한 달 반 가까이 1500원대 고공행진을 이어가고 있다.

headlines.title: 스마트폰 허용에 월급 오르자 … 군장병 온라인도박·빚투 노출
headlines.summary: 군장병 한해 1천명 채무조정 입대전 가족부양·의료비로 카드론·신용대출 받은 경우 불어난 이자 감당 못하기도 단순한 개인 금융문제 넘어 국가안보에도 부정적 요인 "청년문제 구조적 연장선" #육군 일병 A씨(21)는 입대 후 받은 월급으로 가상자산 투자를 시작했지만 손실을 피하지 못했다. 이후 A씨는 과거 손실을 만회하기 위해 온라인 도박에 손을 댔다.

headlines.title: 과세 지연에 … 전자담배 액상 100년치 사재기
headlines.summary: 입법 전 수입한 액상 니코틴 과세 못해…"누락 세수 16조" 액상 전자담배 관리 방치 틈타 천연 니코틴, 합성으로 둔갑 위장 수입·유통량 3억병 추정 "생태계 왜곡…전수 조사 필요" 사진=뉴스1 작년 말 국회를 통과한 담배사업법 개정안이 지난 4월 24일 시행되면서 37년간 ‘연초의 잎’이었던 담배 정의가 ‘연초나 니코틴’으로 확대됐다.

headlines.title: [단독] 사상최대 초과세수 투입해 10대 랜드마크사업 키운다
headlines.summary: 내달 재정전략회의서 구체화 광주 팹·동남권 피지컬 AI 등 靑 김용범 언급한 곳도 포함 정부가 연간 수십조 원이 넘을 것으로 예상되는 세수 증가분을 미래 성장동력을 육성하는 '랜드마크 프로젝트'에 투입하는 방안을 논의 중이다. 랜드마크(Landmark)는 멀리서도 눈에 띄는 상징물을 가리킨다.

headlines.title: [단독] " 제2 의 반도체 키워라 "… 제조AX 집중육성
headlines.summary: 기획처, 랜드마크 프로젝트 신산업 발굴해 성장률 제고 조 단위 예산 중장기 투자 AI고속도로·로봇·전력망 등 부처 협의해 내달 최종 선정 정부가 2027년도 예산안의 핵심 골격이 될 '랜드마크 프로젝트'를 통해 제조업 인공지능(AI) 혁신을 국가 역점 사업으로 추진할 전망이다.

key_headlines.title: Government to Pursue Manufacturing AI as Landmark Project with Hundreds of Billions in Budget
key_headlines.summary: The Korean government plans to designate Manufacturing AI innovation as a national priority project through landmark projects funded with massive budgets for 2027, aiming to discover new growth drivers comparable to semiconductors.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Hovers Near 1,500 Won for 1.5 Months Amid External Pressures
key_headlines.summary: The Korean won-dollar exchange rate has remained in the 1,500 won range for nearly 1.5 months, nearing 1,550 won intraday, driven by U.S. rate hike expectations and foreign selling, with apparent intervention by currency authorities.

key_headlines.title: Government Reduces Oil Maximum Price by 150 Won, Expected to Fall to 1,800 Won Range
key_headlines.summary: The government cut the maximum oil price by 150 won on June 26th, with gasoline prices expected to drop from the 2,000 won range to the 1,800 won range early next week, as part of broader price stabilization efforts.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Electronics and SK Group Leaders to Announce Major Investment Plans on June 29th
key_headlines.summary: Samsung Electronics Vice Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won will announce record-breaking investment plans at a presidential briefing, with combined investments expected to reach trillions of won in semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI.

key_headlines.title: Korean Companies Emerge as Core Partners in Tesla Ecosystem Amid U.S.-China Tensions
key_headlines.summary: Korean companies including LG Energy Solution and Samsung Electronics are becoming key partners for Tesla in batteries, robotics, and components, replacing Chinese suppliers as U.S.-China tensions persist.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is pursuing manufacturing AI as a landmark national project with multi-trillion won investments across multiple fields including AI highways, robotics, and power grids. The government also announced immediate price stabilization measures, cutting maximum oil prices by 150 won with expectations that gasoline will fall to the 1,800 won range next week. Additionally, a record-breaking youth asset-building savings program launched five days ago already exceeded 1 million applicants with annual interest rates of 7-8%. The government is utilizing surplus tax revenues to fund landmark projects while managing price pressures from external factors including Middle East tensions and abnormal weather patterns.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is leveraging record-breaking surplus tax revenues exceeding tens of trillions of won to fund major landmark projects focused on future growth engines including semiconductor manufacturing in Honam and physical AI in the Southeast region. The government has allocated 1 trillion won for civilian price stabilization, freezing electricity and gas rates while reducing oil prices proactively to manage inflation expectations. Next week's key economic indicators will include U.S. employment data, domestic consumer price inflation rates, and Chinese manufacturing PMI, with concerns about uncontrollable external variables such as Middle East instability and adverse weather affecting food prices. Korea's power industry is intensifying exports to Vietnam, which is experiencing 7.1% annual GDP growth and rapid electrification demand.
sections.Financial Markets: Government bonds showed mixed results on June 26th as safe-asset demand from stock market volatility offset exchange rate concerns, with 3-year bonds yielding 3.722% annually. Micron stock movements are now closely tracking Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix stock, indicating that Korean semiconductor stocks have become a key market variable affecting global markets including New York and Tokyo exchanges. The weak link in financial markets broke under aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing rapid market sentiment shifts and asset price collapses that had reflected optimistic expectations. U.S. investment surpassing 1 trillion dollars and foreign investor portfolio outflows continue to support the weak won, preventing the exchange rate from falling despite increased corporate dollar deposits reaching 112.2 billion dollars.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korean companies including LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, and Samsung Electronics are becoming core partners in Tesla's ecosystem across batteries, energy storage, robotics, and components as the company shifts supply chains from Chinese to Korean suppliers amid U.S.-China tensions. China is aggressively securing rare earth and critical materials including tungsten from North Korea to secure semiconductor and AI supply chains. The government confirmed sufficient water supply in Honam for semiconductor plant development, responding to concerns about regional water shortages. Korean robot companies like ING Robotics are raising over 22 billion won in investment to develop physical AI capabilities while competing on quality and cost-effectiveness against Chinese competitors.
sections.Real Estate: Among Seoul's 25 districts, 20 have surpassed their 2021 peak apartment prices, demonstrating continued triple strength with simultaneous increases in sales, jeonse, and monthly rental prices. The Dongtan New City area is experiencing abnormal price overheating with prices rising 11.38% since early June, the fastest nationwide, with flagship properties reaching 2.7 billion won. Seoul's real estate supply concerns focus on building demolition and relocation demand rather than new construction, with complex supply-demand dynamics continuing despite lending restrictions and interest rate burdens. New supply projects in the Daegu-Gyeongbuk region are attracting strong pre-application demand from prospective buyers, particularly for the Pentagon Hills W complex beginning special applications on June 29th.
sections.International Economy: President Trump threatened 100% tariffs on countries implementing digital service taxes, directly targeting EU tech companies and escalating potential U.S.-EU trade conflicts regardless of existing trade agreements. The IMF chief economist warned that U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapse would increase global economic risks, noting rapid changes in global trade order following Trump administration tariff policies. The EU has been concluding trade agreements with Central/South America and India in response to U.S. tariff pressures, reflecting strategic realignment in global trade relationships.
sections.AI & Economy: Middle-aged and older workers seeking reemployment face structural market challenges despite experience and willingness, with 56.6% concerned about job availability and only 40.3% optimistic about employability, highlighting the need for AI skill acquisition for career transitions. The U.S. government relaxed export controls on Anthropic's latest AI models Mistral-5 and Fable-5 just two weeks after imposing restrictions, allowing some companies to use the technology despite national security concerns about sensitive countries. Hyundai's redesigned Elantra featuring next-generation infotainment systems and generative AI marks the shift toward software-defined vehicles (SDVs), with AI becoming a core differentiator in automotive in-cabin experiences at major motor shows.
sections.Others: The government finalized the 6th Science and Technology Basic Plan committing 200 trillion won in R&D investment over five years for AI transformation and scientific innovation. Individual investors returned to net purchasing of SK Hynix Leverage ETFs for the first time in four weeks, indicating shifted market sentiment in ETF markets. OpenAI is considering postponing its IPO to 2027 and maintaining a 1 trillion dollar valuation expectation, as market confidence in IPOs declines following SpaceX stock collapses and AI company valuation concerns, with the company requiring more time to achieve sustained profitability.
